name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport PR was somewhat accidental. He initially pursued a journalism degree, but a chance internship with a local racing team ignited his passion. He quickly realized his talent lay in crafting compelling narratives and managing public perception. Ricardo thrives on the fast-paced, high-stakes environment of racing, and he's known for his ability to spin even the most challenging situations into positive opportunities.

He takes a meticulous approach to his work, believing that attention to detail is paramount in building and maintaining a strong brand image. He is experienced in both traditional and digital media, and he has a knack for building strong relationships with journalists and influencers. At Century Motorsport, he's responsible for managing the team's media relations, crafting press releases, and overseeing social media strategy. Ricardo is a firm believer in transparency and authenticity, and he works tirelessly to ensure the team is presented in the best possible light.

 Ricardo’s experience makes him a valuable asset in managing media perceptions, but his perfectionist tendencies can sometimes lead to delays and frustration with others.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled with a side part.
physical.description: Ricardo is of average height with a slightly athletic build.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, even in digital meetings.
Insists on using Oxford commas in all written communication.
Has a framed photo of Ayrton Senna on his desk, which he often talks to when facing a difficult decision.
